verdict.rationale: Visa publishes open source for adjacent components: a hands-on probe confirms the Trusted Agent Protocol spec and its reference implementation (tap-agent, agent-registry, cdn-proxy, merchant-backend) are public under an open license. The Agent Toolkit/MCP server is also hosted on a public GitHub repo. The core Intelligent Commerce platform itself (tokenization, mandates, credential controls) is a closed, credential-gated API whose source is not available. missing for 10: open source for the core Intelligent Commerce platform/APIs, explicit license confirmation for the agent-toolkit repo, independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
